ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 55% high-intensity (white) pixels and 45% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe is primarily high-intensity with a low-intensity trailing margin. A central low-intensity block separates the lobes. The right lobe contains a large, distinct elliptical high-intensity blob (~30% of lobe area) isolated within a low-intensity field, with high-intensity mottling at the distal margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 80 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays low-amplitude, low-frequency irregularities. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, high-amplitude serrations with at least 6 distinct peaks visible between the notch and the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the outer edges of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of approximately 12 high-intensity circular pixel groups (white spots) located on the distal low-intensity region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct low-intensity linear disruption (~45-degree angle) traversing the high-intensity region of the left lobe from the medial base toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe jagged truncation and irregular pixel topography at the distal tip of the right lobe, indicating significant physical trauma or heavy scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'island' configuration of high-intensity pigment on the right lobe, almost entirely enclosed by low-intensity pixels.
